corrections.reason: The glyph has the top horizontal bar of 'ሲ' ('ሲወርሷት' - when they inherit it gradually), misread as 'ሊ'.
In the image, 'ሊበሉት' is clearly printed with the object suffix 'ት' before 'ይቀርባሉ'.
The second 'ድ' in 'ከጉድጓዱ' has the 2nd-order vowel stroke on the right ('ዱ', matching L04 'ከጉድጓዱ').

Standard Andemta legal contrast: 'ቢረታ ዳኝነት ቢረቱ መማለጃ ይበሉታልና' (if he wins the case, they eat court fees; if he loses [passive ቢረቱ/ቢረታ], they eat bribes), and the second 'ቢረቱ' shows the side stroke of 'ቱ'.
The printed text reads 'አውካር' (variant manuscript reading for 'ምጽላል' / nest/boudoir) with 'ው' (or 'ብው'), where the rounded loop is 'ው'.
The printed word is 'ከጉባዔው' (if he spent time in the assembly/gathering, it is customary to call everyone a disciple), misread as 'ከገብዔው'.
